perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Dual Loader
perks.desc: Reloads an additional shot at a time.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Search Party
perks.desc: This weapon is granted faster aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.

notes: Inspired by @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll backup sustained Boss damage in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Arcane Embrace was the first heavy burst frame shotgun and are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic. While they struggle to find a defined role in the current sandbox, the subfamily does offer good single mag damage. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers, and are helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3328019216 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine Size is 12 (max 16) - each trigger pull fires two shots - and total ammo is 36. The usual play for shotguns of boosting Handling with the barrel perk still applies and, as there's no Assault Mag, look to a magazine perk that helps with Reload Speed. For sustained boss damage, once you're out of heavy ammo, there's the perk trait combination of Fourth Time's the Charm to refill 2 shots from reserves after 4 crits within 2s (3s when enhanced) of each other and Precision Instrument which also procs on crit hits granting up to 6 stacks of escalating damage for ×1.25 (×1.3 when enhanced) for 1.25s or until you miss a crit. Alternatively, if you're in a fireteam or a Transcendent subclass, Aggregate Charge provides a stack for each different elemental debuff up to ×3 stacks to boost damage by ×1.3 (×1.33 when enhanced), with each stack lasting as long as the debuff is active. For the Origin Trait, there's only Search Party which applies a ×0.85 ADS animation scalar and ×1.1 ADS movement speed when there are no allies within 15m. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Arcane Embrace is the newest frame to Destiny 2. A double fire slug shotgun. Each trigger pull fires two semi-deadly slugs. (Only semi if you can hit your shots). Over in your regular PvE activities it shouldn't matter unless you regularly GM or something. Fourth Times the Charm will give you one extra trigger pull for two consecutive burst crits. Precision Instrument stacks quickly on double fire frames and will work nicely against chunky health bars and champions. Surrounded can work better depending on the encounter and how confident you are at staying alive. Bonus points for Desperado for shotgun go brrrrr." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Arcane Embrace is not good in PvP. You need to land both shots to kill and one *has* to be a crit in order for you to secure the kill. Tap the Trigger and Closing Time both help your accuracy and Lone Wolf will boost your mid tier aim assist. If you treat this like a normal shotgun or slug you're going to have a bad time." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 121 from 5 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/64p7wnHATJnZB8jnnJUnhP?si=f5552155425a4d6a) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for backup sustained Boss damage in general and end-game, underleveled, content. Arcane Embrace is the first of a new subfamily of Heavy Burst shotguns, which look like they might be the new top pick for special weapon boss DPS, doing 9.88% more damage that slug shotguns if both shits hit. The stats look similar to Pin Point Slug shotties too, and by that standard are pretty decent. At base, with 0/1/2/3 Reserve mods, you hold total ammo of 26/29/33/34, but you can chew through ammo fast, firing two shots with each trigger pull. The usual play for shotguns of boosting handling with the barrel perk still applies and, as there's no Assault Mag, look to a magazine perk that helps with Reload Speed. For sustained boss damage, once you're out of heavy ammo, the perk trait combination of Fourth Time's the Charm and Precision Instrument, if you can consistently hit a boss crit spot to take advantage of the up to ×1.25 boost to precision damage and extend your mag. The Search Party origin trait, gaining better ADS and strafe speed when on your own, might be useful when you're away from your fireteam, but think of it more as a useful added extra when it's procced. Recommended MW: Handling, Reload Speed depending on your preference, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.0.4 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Majors, Champions and Bosses in general and end-game, underleveled, content, particularly with arc builds. Arcane Embrace is the first of a new subfamily of Heavy Burst shotguns, which look like they might be the new top pick for special weapon boss DPS, doing 9.88% more damage that slug shotguns if both shits hit. The stats look similar to Pin Point Slug shotties too, and by that standard are pretty decent. At base, with 0/1/2/3 Reserve mods, you hold total ammo of 26/29/33/34, but you can chew through ammo fast, firing two shots with each trigger pull. The usual play for shotguns of boosting handling with the barrel perk still applies and, as there's no Assault Mag, look to a magazine perk that helps with Reload Speed. If you've not yet got a Voltshot shotgun, this is a decent choice - you could use Dual Loader or Threat Detector for better reloads after a kill (you only need to reload a single shell, not the whole mag which should take less than a second), to then proc Voltshot to apply Jolt for decent chunk damage on a target and AoE lightning for some crowd control too, to synergise with arc fragments. The Search Party origin trait, gaining better ADS and strafe speed when on your own, might be useful when you're away from your fireteam, but think of it more as a useful added extra when it's procced. Recommended MW: Handling, Reload Speed depending on your preference, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to generate Ionic Traces or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.
